findings.claim: The adapters can return HTTP 201 for a minted installation token before its metadata and authorization are durable, so an immediate cold start loses both; an ordinary persistence failure makes the loss permanent.
findings.evidence: packages/@emulators/core/src/adapter-runtime.ts:335-339 calls enqueueSave without await, and lines 240-248 swallow non-fail-closed save failures. durability-race.json records 201 then metadataCount 0 and tokenAuthStatus 401 before the save settles. persistence-failure.json records 201, a swallowed failed save, metadataCount 0, and tokenAuthStatus 401. The changed contract test at tests/contracts/github-app-identity.js:239 waits for persistence before cold-starting, so it cannot reject this implementation.
findings.layer: durable adapter commit point and immediate cold-start boundary
